original_sql:
SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) AS n_orders
FROM customer c
WHERE c.c_nationkey = 7

candidates.sql: SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS n_orders FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = 7 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name
candidates.rationale: Use a LEFT JOIN to avoid the correlated subquery, which runs per outer row.
